platePrompt: A moody, intimate third-wave coffee bar with rich dark walnut surfaces, a gleaming brass espresso machine, and a single perfect latte with intricate foam art. Dramatic side lighting from a single pendant lamp creates deep shadows and warm highlights. Raw concrete walls with a single trailing pothos plant. The palette is deep espresso browns, warm cream, and oxidized copper. Spacious composition with generous negative space. Shot on Hasselblad X2D, 90mm macro lens, f/2.0, photorealistic.
